Ananta Pr. Barik vs Land Acquisition Collector on 9 August,
2024
 In The High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
 L.A.A. No.02 of 2012
 Ananta Pr. Barik .... Appellant

entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Mr. N. Panda,
 Advocate
 -versus-
 Land Acquisition Collector, .... Respondent

Mr. B. Panigrahi,
 Additional Standing Counsel
 Coram: Justice Sanjay Kumar Mishra
11 . This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

2. Heard Mr. Panda, learned Counsel for the Appellant and Mr. Panigrahi, learned Additional Standing Counsel for the Respondent.
3.

The present Appeal has been preferred under Section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894,
shortly, L.A. Act, 1894, challenging order dated 28.03.1998 passed by the Civil Judge (Senior Division), Bhadrak (hereinafter referred to as "Referral Court"), in L.A. Misc. Case No.336 of 1996.

4. Mr. Panda, learned Counsel for the Appellant draws attention of this Court to Paragraph-2 of the impugned judgment, vide which it has been clearly mentioned that in terms of various preliminary notifications made under Section 4(I) of the Act,1894, published on different dates in Orissa Gazette Extraordinary, lands measuring an area of Ac.217.71 decimals in three Villages i.e. Helpur,
Majurigadia and Pahamahura, under Dhamngar Tahasil, were acquired by the State on requisition of IDCO for establishment of a Private Sugar Factory namely, Dharani Sugar and Chemicals Limited in Mouza Majurigadia.
5.

Mr. Panda further submits, this Appeal is covered by the judgments passed by the coordinate Bench in LAA No.4 of 2012 dated 20.06.2022 and LAA No.143 of 2010, L.A.A. No.144 of 2010, both dated 20.06.2022, and order dated 13.03.2024 passed in L.A.A. No.71 of 2011.

6. Copies of the said judgments and order being supplied to the learned Additional Standing Counsel for the State-Respondent, after examining the said judgments and order, Mr. Panigrahi,
Ananta Pr. Barik vs Land Acquisition Collector on 9 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/169194817/
1 learned ASC does not dispute the said submission made by Mr. Panda, learned Counsel for the Appellant that the present Appeal is squarely covered by the said judgments passed by this Court,
kissam of the land in question being same and situated in the same village so also acquired for the same purpose, though notifications made under Section 4(I) of the Act,1894, were published on different dates.
7.

sentences.text: Accordingly, this Appeal stands disposed of holding that the Appellant (claimant before the Referral Court) is entitled to compensation @ Rs.1,50,000/- per acre for acquiring his land.

Accordingly, the compensation @ Rs.1,50,000/- per acre be computed and paid to the Appellant with all other statutory benefits within a period of six weeks from the date of communication/production of the certified copy of this order.
8. The Appeal is allowed to the extent as indicated above and stands disposed of.
(S. K. Mishra) Prasant Judge Signed by: PRASANT KUMAR PRADHAN Reason: Authentication
